artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a path lined by bare trees. The path curves left towards buildings stretching into the distance. The horizon is not visible. The scene features delicate linework typical of etching, with intricate tree branches. The color palette is monochromatic with dark lines on an off-white background. Individuals are loosely sketched in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a residential area with barren trees, rooftops of houses, and people walking along fences. The trees sway in the wind, their branches extending in various directions. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic black and white style, with expressive lines creating a sense of movement and a sketch-like quality. The horizon is high, showing rooftops and the sun above it.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man (Der Sündenfall)
artworks.description: Bold black shapes and lines form two human-like figures engaged with a tall, twisting column at the center of the composition. The interaction of light and dark areas creates textured patterns. The curving lines and shapes evoke silhouettes of people dancing or gazing towards each other. The background is filled with expressive, radiating lines.

artworks.title: The Barn
artworks.description: The image shows three pencil sketches of farm animals in a barn setting. The first sketch has two horses at a feeding trough, the second has two adult horses and a colt, and the third has three cows in a stall. The sketches are in various shades of gray. The arrangement of the animals differs in each sketch.

artworks.title: Brudermord (Cain and Abel)
artworks.description: The image features bold, dynamic lines and contrasting shapes forming an abstract composition. The overlapping lines and forms suggest outlines of human figures in motion, appearing engaged in interaction or struggle. The angular lines and shadows create a sense of movement and drama.

artworks.title: Christus am Kreuz (The Crucifixion)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is portrayed with arms outstretched in a crucifixion pose in a monochromatic black and white scheme. The illustration depicts a halo surrounding the head of the central figure. To the left and right, two additional figures are present, each rendered with sharp lines. The figures are surrounded by a background of abstract lines, enhancing the intensity of the composition. This is in the style of Emil Nolde, known for his expressionist approach to religious subjects and use of woodcut techniques.

artworks.title: Austreibung aus dem Paradies (The Expulsion from Paradise)
artworks.description: The image features bold, contrasting lines and shapes that swirl and converge, creating a dense abstract composition. Three humanoid figures are depicted, with one central figure wrapped in elongated lines. Other figures nearby suggest familiar human poses and expressions. The background includes lines resembling sharp peaks or mountains.

artworks.title: Götz von Berlichingen
artworks.description: The image depicts two standing figures and a horse in black silhouette against a lighter background. The figures appear to be in motion, with one slightly more pronounced in the foreground and the horse's head visible between them. The textures are rough with confident, broad strokes, conveying a sense of dynamic movement and tension. The style is reminiscent of George Grosz.

artworks.title: Interior
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 27.5 x 31.8 cm (10 13/16 x 12 1/2 in.)
support: 31.3 x 36.7 cm (12 5/16 x 14 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This pencil sketch features a wooden barrel and a large covered container in the foreground. To the left, a rustic kitchen area is depicted with a stove, pots, a kettle, and a chimney. The color palette is primarily grey.

artworks.title: Egge (Harrow)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two large, tilted structures that resemble scaffolding or fence sections. They are positioned diagonally within the composition. The horizon line is high in the image, with sketchy details in the background. The brushstrokes create movement and texture, with crosshatching suggesting shading and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying tones of black on a light beige backdrop. The perspective and color usage give the image a stark and minimalist visual impact.

artworks.title: Totenmaske Liebknechts (Liebknecht's Death Mask)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch portrait showing the head and part of the shoulder area of the subject, who is facing to the right with a slight upward tilt to their chin. The facial features depicted include closed eyes, a pronounced nose, and full lips. The hair is closely cropped or possibly shaved, shown through shaded pencil strokes that emphasize the texture. The subject appears to be wearing a collared garment, indicated by the lines suggesting the collar around the neck area. The sketch is rendered in various shades of black and grey against a plain, untextured background. There is handwritten text beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a portrait of a person facing forward, with dark sketched facial features emphasized by the shading. The person wears a broad-brimmed hat that is slightly tilted to one side. The clothing features a collar around the neck. The background is plain and light, with text and signatures on the right side.

artworks.title: Sheet of Sketches
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring studies of a man in different poses and angles. The central figure is dressed in a long coat, trousers, and boots, sitting with crossed legs and one arm resting on his knee. A cane is leaning against a fence beside him. His face, depicted in profile, shows a pronounced nose and chin, with a pipe in his mouth. He wears a wide-brimmed hat, revealing textured short hair underneath. Other sketches show his hands holding objects like a bottle or stick, and smaller drawings of his face in various angles. The background is plain, keeping the focus on the man's features.

artworks.title: Thomas
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person. The individual is seated with a relaxed posture, featuring an expressive face with bold lines. The hair is depicted with loose strokes. The clothing is suggested with broad lines. The background is plain. A signature or inscription is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Frauenbildnis (Portrait of a Woman)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of the upper half of a person's body. The person is seated, with their hands in their lap. The facial features are drawn with bold lines, depicting a serious expression with prominent eyes and a slightly open mouth. The hair is short and textured, combed to one side. The figure is wearing a loose garment with simple lines and a high collar around the neck. The background is plain with minimal details.

artworks.title: Lesender Mönch (Priest Reading)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from head to thighs. The individual is looking down at something they are holding. The facial features are simple, with a defined nose and eyes closed or looking down. The hair is short and the person is clad in a buttoned shirt. They are holding something rectangular, possibly a book or tablet, with both hands. The background is plain and lacks detail.

artworks.title: Debut from "Paradise and the Peri" (3rdplate )
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. The figure on the right is shown from head to toe, appear to be standing or floating with one arm raised above their head. Their facial features are softly drawn, with hair styled close to the head, dressed in a flowing, textured garment resembling a long robe or gown. On the left, another figure is seated from the waist up, with their head slightly bowed. The background features a softly rendered, abstract environment.

artworks.title: Animal Sketches
artworks.description: This image depicts five sketches of pigs in various poses. The pigs are shown from different angles and positions, with simple but expressive line work capturing their essence with minimal details. One pig is illustrated in a side view on the top left, another facing left on the top right, and a group of three pigs from behind below. A single pig from the rear is on the bottom left, while another from a back-centered perspective is on the bottom right. The drawing's minimalist style and soft pencil lines create an elegant and spontaneous feel.

artworks.title: The British Lion
artworks.description: A drawing of a sea lion balancing a globe on its nose. The sea lion is depicted sitting on its hind flippers with a detailed world globe on its nose. The text "DER BRITISCHE LEU" is written underneath. Next to the sea lion, there is a smaller animal resembling a bear. The drawing is in monochrome with detailed textures.

artworks.title: Pigs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several pigs. The image shows a group of pigs depicted in different postures; in the foreground, there are four pigs, some standing and one lying down, while in the background two larger pigs are resting on the ground. The drawing is rendered in a simplistic, sketch-like style. The pigs are drawn in thin, dark lines against a plain, light background.

artworks.title: The Woodcutter
artworks.description: The image shows a person swinging an axe in an action pose. The person has their arms raised above their head and their body slightly leaning forward. They have a concentrated expression, short hair, and are wearing a striped short-sleeved shirt, pants, and shoes. The background includes a vertical log and some indistinct shapes. The sketch is done in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Hiddensee I
artworks.description: The image offers an elevated view of a coastal landscape. The horizon separates the sea from the sky. Small details like sailing boats can be seen on the water. The foreground features rolling hills depicted with smooth brushstrokes. A line of trees, houses, and a larger building can be spotted beyond the hills. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey.

artworks.title: Woman Tying Her Shoe (Frau, Schuh Zuknopfend)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a black and white woodcut style, featuring a seated figure with one leg crossed over the other. The person has distinct facial features, with an angular face, long nose, closed eyes, and prominent cheekbones. The hair is styled elegantly and the clothing includes a high-collar dress with bold lines and patterns on the shoulders and arms. Abstract shapes and another figure in a contemplative posture are visible in the background. The overall background is heavily textured with sharp lines and contrasts, merging the figures with their surroundings.

artworks.title: Dr. Burchard
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a seated man in sketch style. He is sitting upright on a chair, one arm on his leg and the other on the armrest. He has a bald head with a mustache, a stern expression, and is wearing a suit. There is a plain, neutral background.
